title: Signed invoice paperwork and smarter timesheets
notes: Show approved linked field tickets directly inside client invoice details, including a View signed ticket action.
Return linked approved field tickets from the secure customer invoice detail RPC without exposing other customer records.
Use a real visible signature in the lived-in demo and route the demo Client view through Northborn's actual client portal.
Allow timesheets to store a manual job, invoice, PO or other reference number when no Northborn job should be linked.
Only allow a timesheet to link jobs assigned to that employee through Dispatch, with the rule enforced in the UI and database.
Replace timesheet native selects with reusable Northborn dropdown menus and improve styling for remaining native selects.
Fix GitHub Pages timesheet print links and show the manual reference on printable timesheets.
